en.text: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

zhSimplified.text: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道吗？ 母鹿下犊之期，你能察定吗？

zhTraditional.text: 山巖間的野山羊幾時生產，你知道嗎？ 母鹿下犢之期，你能察定嗎？

en.text: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

zhSimplified.text: 它们怀胎的月数，你能数算吗？ 它们几时生产，你能晓得吗？

zhTraditional.text: 牠們懷胎的月數，你能數算嗎？ 牠們幾時生產，你能曉得嗎？

en.text: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

zhSimplified.text: 它们屈身，将子生下， 就除掉疼痛。

zhTraditional.text: 牠們屈身，將子生下， 就除掉疼痛。

en.text: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

zhSimplified.text: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大， 去而不回。

zhTraditional.text: 這子漸漸肥壯，在荒野長大， 去而不回。

en.text: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

zhSimplified.text: 谁放野驴出去自由？ 谁解开快驴的绳索？

zhTraditional.text: 誰放野驢出去自由？ 誰解開快驢的繩索？

en.text: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

zhSimplified.text: 我使旷野作它的住处， 使咸地当它的居所。

zhTraditional.text: 我使曠野作牠的住處， 使鹹地當牠的居所。

en.text: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

zhSimplified.text: 它嗤笑城内的喧嚷， 不听赶牲口的喝声。

zhTraditional.text: 牠嗤笑城內的喧嚷， 不聽趕牲口的喝聲。

en.text: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

zhSimplified.text: 遍山是它的草场； 它寻找各样青绿之物。

zhTraditional.text: 遍山是牠的草場； 牠尋找各樣青綠之物。

en.text: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

zhSimplified.text: 野牛岂肯服事你？ 岂肯住在你的槽旁？

zhTraditional.text: 野牛豈肯服事你？ 豈肯住在你的槽旁？

en.text: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

zhSimplified.text: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间？ 它岂肯随你耙山谷之地？

zhTraditional.text: 你豈能用套繩將野牛籠在犂溝之間？ 牠豈肯隨你耙山谷之地？

en.text: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

zhSimplified.text: 岂可因它的力大就倚靠它？ 岂可把你的工交给它做吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈可因牠的力大就倚靠牠？ 豈可把你的工交給牠做嗎？

en.text: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

zhSimplified.text: 岂可信靠它把你的粮食运到家， 又收聚你禾场上的谷吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈可信靠牠把你的糧食運到家， 又收聚你禾場上的穀嗎？

en.text: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

zhSimplified.text: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然搧展， 岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛吗？

zhTraditional.text: 鴕鳥的翅膀歡然搧展， 豈是顯慈愛的翎毛和羽毛嗎？

en.text: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

zhSimplified.text: 因它把蛋留在地上， 在尘土中使得温暖；

zhTraditional.text: 因牠把蛋留在地上， 在塵土中使得溫暖；

en.text: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

zhSimplified.text: 却想不到被脚踹碎， 或被野兽践踏。

zhTraditional.text: 卻想不到被腳踹碎， 或被野獸踐踏。

en.text: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

zhSimplified.text: 它忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的； 虽然徒受劳苦，也不为雏惧怕；

zhTraditional.text: 牠忍心待雛，似乎不是自己的； 雖然徒受勞苦，也不為雛懼怕；

en.text: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 因为 神使它没有智慧， 也未将悟性赐给它。

zhTraditional.text: 因為上帝使牠沒有智慧， 也未將悟性賜給牠。

en.text: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

zhSimplified.text: 它几时挺身展开翅膀， 就嗤笑马和骑马的人。

zhTraditional.text: 牠幾時挺身展開翅膀， 就嗤笑馬和騎馬的人。

en.text: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

zhSimplified.text: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？ 它颈项上挓挲的鬃是你给它披上的吗？

zhTraditional.text: 馬的大力是你所賜的嗎？ 牠頸項上挓挲的誃是你給牠披上的嗎？

en.text: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

zhSimplified.text: 是你叫它跳跃像蝗虫吗？ 它喷气之威使人惊惶。

zhTraditional.text: 是你叫牠跳躍像蝗蟲嗎？ 牠噴氣之威使人驚惶。

en.text: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

zhSimplified.text: 它在谷中刨地，自喜其力； 它出去迎接佩带兵器的人。

zhTraditional.text: 牠在谷中刨地，自喜其力； 牠出去迎接佩帶兵器的人。

en.text: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

zhSimplified.text: 它嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶， 也不因刀剑退回。

zhTraditional.text: 牠嗤笑可怕的事並不驚惶， 也不因刀劍退回。

en.text: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

zhSimplified.text: 箭袋和发亮的枪， 并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。

zhTraditional.text: 箭袋和發亮的槍， 並短槍在牠身上錚錚有聲。

en.text: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

zhSimplified.text: 它发猛烈的怒气将地吞下； 一听角声就不耐站立。

zhTraditional.text: 牠發猛烈的怒氣將地吞下； 一聽角聲就不耐站立。

en.text: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

zhSimplified.text: 角每发声，它说呵哈； 它从远处闻着战气， 又听见军长大发雷声和兵丁呐喊。

zhTraditional.text: 角每發聲，牠說呵哈； 牠從遠處聞着戰氣， 又聽見軍長大發雷聲和兵丁吶喊。

en.text: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

zhSimplified.text: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南， 岂是借你的智慧吗？

zhTraditional.text: 鷹雀飛翔，展開翅膀一直向南， 豈是藉你的智慧嗎？

en.text: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

zhSimplified.text: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝， 岂是听你的吩咐吗？

zhTraditional.text: 大鷹上騰在高處搭窩， 豈是聽你的吩咐嗎？

en.text: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

zhSimplified.text: 它住在山岩， 以山峰和坚固之所为家，

zhTraditional.text: 牠住在山巖， 以山峰和堅固之所為家，

en.text: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

zhSimplified.text: 从那里窥看食物， 眼睛远远观望。

zhTraditional.text: 從那裏窺看食物， 眼睛遠遠觀望。

en.text: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

zhSimplified.text: 它的雏也咂血； 被杀的人在哪里，它也在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 牠的雛也咂血； 被殺的人在哪裏，牠也在那裏。
